courses.title: Introduction To Economics
courses.choice_note: ECON 2300 , ECON 2301 , or ECON 2302 satisfy the Core Curriculum requirement for Component Area VIII (Social and Behavioral Sciences). The total hours reflect the inclusion of MATH 1324 and ECON 2300 , ECON 2301 , or ECON 2302 . If the student does not have prior credit for MATH 1324 and ECON 2300 , ECON 2301 , or ECON 2302 , the total hours increase to 126.
